publication.title: WarMemoirSampo: A Semantic Portal for War Veteran Interview Videos

source_reading.scope: Main §§1–5, RDF data model, deployed portal interactions, extraction checks, limitations and code/service footnotes; bibliography not read integrally.

adjudication.basis: WarMemoirSampo provides faceted search and entity navigation over an actual RDF graph linking interviews, time slices, named entities and external resources. Its video position and contextual table of contents are synchronized. Evaluation concerns the extraction pipeline; the report supplies no recruited portal-user study.

limitations: Extraction quality is not portal usability or retrieval task success.

descriptions.interaction: Facet/text search over interviews, time slices and named entities; navigate instance pages/external linked entities and seek relevant video segments through a dynamic table of contents.
descriptions.guidance: Temporal position expands the corresponding contextual segment and named entities; instance pages aggregate related KG information.
descriptions.visualisation: ["Faceted result lists", "Entity descriptions", "Related-place map", "Word cloud", "Embedded video", "Synchronized segmented table of contents"]
descriptions.backend: RDF time-segmented interview KG with links to WarSampo, Wikidata and YSO
